Helpful bulletin for returning guests
It is easier with this note

Travelers should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk early so the team can help prepare companion animals for a steady journey. Aurelia Skyways keeps the process calm and practical, and the welcome team works with handlers who use gentle, humane methods around each animal.

Please make sure your pet is ready for a smooth handoff, with the right travel items close by and your own papers in order. If you are moving through the airport with a companion animal, the desk can help guide you through the usual steps, answer simple concerns, and point you toward the right boarding support. This service is meant to keep the trip dependable for both guests and animals, while giving everyone a quieter start.

If you are traveling with a pet, please allow a little extra care for each stage of the trip. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is ready to help with calm guidance and a clear route to boarding support. Companion Animal Travel Desk
